label: positive
description: setFee() loses its onlyOwner modifier with no inline replacement; any caller can now overwrite the protocol fee. setFeeRecipient() keeps onlyOwner, isolating the regression to a single function.
why_labeled: A previously owner-only state-changing function became callable by anyone, and no compensating access check (inline require, upstream gate, visibility change) was added in the same commit. This is the canonical SC01 access-control regression on an ordinary state-changing function and must fire.
